title: Explicit constants for the standing density bounds
statement: For every n ∈ ℕ there exist real numbers δ₁ and C₁ with 0 < δ₁ ≤ 1/8, C₁ > 0 and C₁δ₁ ≤ 1/2 such that e^δ(1 + δ)/(1 − 4δ)ⁿ ≤ 1 + C₁δ for every real δ with 0 ≤ δ ≤ δ₁.
lean_statement: ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ δ₁ C₁ : ℝ, 0 < δ₁ ∧ δ₁ ≤ 1 / 8 ∧ 0 < C₁ ∧ C₁ * δ₁ ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 ≤ δ → δ ≤ δ₁ → Real.exp δ * (1 + δ) / (1 - 4 * δ) ^ n ≤ 1 + C₁ * δ
